usage: Refers to a shop that sells skincare products, like cleansers, moisturisers, masks, and sunscreen.
Common in everyday spoken Cantonese when you are talking about going out to buy facial care items.
It is a countable noun in context, so you can say one 護膚品店 or many 護膚品店.
Very natural in shopping situations; for a more general term, people may also say 化妝品店 depending on the store type.

examples.sentence: 我想去嗰間護膚品店睇吓有冇新面霜。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 soeng2 heoi3 go2 gaan1 wu6 fu1 ban2 dim3 tai2 haa5 jau5 mou5 san1 min6 soeng1.
examples.meaning: I want to go to that skincare shop to see whether they have any new face cream.

examples.sentence: 呢間護膚品店啲職員好有禮貌。
examples.jyutping: ni1 gaan1 wu6 fu1 ban2 dim3 dei1 zik6 jyun4 hou2 jau5 lai5 maau6.
examples.meaning: The staff in this skincare shop are very polite.

examples.sentence: 佢喺護膚品店買咗防曬同保濕精華。
examples.jyutping: keoi5 hai2 wu6 fu1 ban2 dim3 maai5 zo2 fong4 saai3 tung4 bou2 sap1 zing1 waa4.
examples.meaning: He bought sunscreen and hydrating serum at the skincare shop.

examples.sentence: 附近有間護膚品店，放工可以順路去睇吓。
examples.jyutping: fu6 gan6 jau5 gaan1 wu6 fu1 ban2 dim3, fong3 gung1 ho2 ji5 seon6 lou6 heoi3 tai2 haa5.
examples.meaning: There is a skincare shop nearby, so I can stop by after work.
